Lab: GetPreAuthInfo_View, sequence diagram -> classes -> IRIS flow
Subset of Healthcare-Claim_V7.00, page "Pre-Auth": a citizen ID (CID) search, the HL7 query PAT-01 and the REST call Getinsurer. Production Insurligent.Interop.Production, namespace INSURLIGENT.
Numbered steps run in IRIS: the table gives their classes in call order. Grey steps run in D1 Front only. A request and its reply share one number.

hospital number, name, birth date, gender
Decision in a BPL (if): dashed box
• Build order in the lab (right to left): BO.HIS.HL7, BO.Insurer.REST, BP.HIS.Patient, BP.GetPreAuthInfoView, BS.GetPreAuthInfoView, Insurligent.REST.Router.
• The answer key is in solution/src/ (class Insurligent.A.B is in solution/src/Insurligent/A/B.cls). Use it only to check your work.
• Right column: the IRIS flow. Each box is a production item or class. N.1, N.2 run inside IRIS after step N. Frames are BPL loops.
